# Portfolio & Creative Engineering Showcase

> A modern, high-performance portfolio showcasing full-stack web applications, graphics, photography, and video productions.

## Overview
This website highlights creative projects, case studies, and engineering capabilities with responsive masonry grids, video streaming, interactive shaders, and smooth transitions.

## Key Sections
- **Projects (/projects)**: Interactive gallery of graphic designs, web applications, media productions, and photography.
- **About**: Profile, background experience, and creative design philosophy.
- **Experience**: Timeline of roles, technical skills, design toolsets, and milestones.
- **Contact**: Reach out for collaborations, freelance work, and engineering inquiries.
